manage.title: Branding
manage.description: Customise your application's name, logo, favicon and primary colour.
manage.app_name_help: Shown in the sidebar, the browser tab and on sign-in.
manage.primary_color_help: Accent colour used across buttons and highlights. Leave blank for the default.
manage.design_pack_help: Restyles the public site. Packs come from the modules you have installed.
manage.design_pack_empty: No installed module provides a design pack.
manage.logo_help: Square PNG or WEBP works best, up to 2 MB. Replaces the default badge in the sidebar.
manage.preset_help: Applies a ready-made colour scheme straight away. Your app name, images and banner are left alone.
manage.banner_help: Shown across the top of every page, signed-in or not. Leave empty to hide it.
manage.banner_placeholder: e.g. Scheduled maintenance on Sunday 02:00–04:00 UTC
manage.logo_dark_help: Optional variant for the sidebar, which stays dark in every theme. Leave empty to reuse the main logo.
manage.favicon_help: Small icon shown in the browser tab. PNG, WEBP or ICO, up to 2 MB.
